prompts.question: Does the company have a company profile on 104 Job Bank showing self-reported employee headcount, capital base and hiring volume, and do those figures match the company's other public records?
prompts.why_it_matters: A live 104 employer profile shows the company really operates and hires in Taiwan, and its self-reported size can be compared with official filings.
prompts.how_to_query: Open 104 Job Bank, enter the company name in the company/job search box and open the matching company profile page.
prompts.found_when: A company profile exists on 104 Job Bank with headcount, capital or active job listings for the company.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search of the full and short company name on 104 Job Bank returns no matching company profile.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The site blocks the search, or the name is common and several similarly named employers cannot be told apart.

prompts.question: Does the company appear as a hiring employer on 518 Bear Job, the SME-focused Taiwanese job portal, with storefront or branch hiring?
prompts.why_it_matters: Presence on 518 shows frontline and retail hiring, which reflects the physical operating footprint of consumer-facing businesses.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the keyword search box on 518 Bear Job with the company name and open any matching company page or job list.
prompts.found_when: A company page or job postings under the company name appear on 518 Bear Job.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean name search on 518 Bear Job returns no company page or postings for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search page will not load, or the name is too generic to identify the right employer.

prompts.question: Is the company listed in the American Chamber of Commerce in Taiwan (AmCham Taiwan) member directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: AmCham membership places the company among recognised multinational and local firms active in Taiwan's business community.

source.name: American Chamber of Commerce in Taiwan (AmCham Taiwan)

prompts.how_to_query: Open the AmCham Taiwan member directory pages and search the member listings for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the AmCham Taiwan member directory.
prompts.not_found_when: The member directory contains no entry for the company after a clean scan of the listings.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member directory is behind a login, fails to load, or the name is too common to match confidently.

prompts.question: Is the company recorded in the Ministry of Labor Violation Database (勞動部違反勞動法令事業單位查詢) for labour law sanctions such as unpaid wages, overtime breaches or occupational accidents?
prompts.why_it_matters: An official labour-violation record signals legal exposure, penalty history and workforce-management failures.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the Ministry of Labor Violation Database query form, enter the company name (事業單位名稱) and submit the search.
prompts.found_when: One or more penalty announcements list the company name with a statute, penalty date or fine.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search of the full and short company name returns no violation announcements.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The query form times out or the name matches many unrelated employers with the same prefix.

prompts.question: Does the company appear in the Control Yuan Political Donations Public Disclosure Platform as a corporate donor to parties or candidates?
prompts.why_it_matters: Documented political donations reveal corporate political ties and lobbying channels that can matter for public-sector work.

source.name: Control Yuan Political Donations Public Disclosure Platform

prompts.how_to_query: Open the platform's donation search, enter the company name or its UBN as the donor and run the query.
prompts.found_when: Donation records list the company as a donor with an amount, recipient and reporting period.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean donor search on the company name and UBN returns no donation records.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search interface or API is unavailable, or the name matches several donors and cannot be separated without a UBN.

prompts.question: Has Business Today (今周刊) published investigative reporting on the company covering ownership disputes, executive controversies or financial engineering?
prompts.why_it_matters: Investigative coverage in a financial weekly exposes governance conflicts and control battles that are not in filings.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Business Today by the company name or its tag page and read any articles naming the company.
prompts.found_when: One or more Business Today articles name the company in connection with ownership, management or financial disputes.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean site search on the company name returns no articles about the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The site search is broken or the name is too generic to separate the company from other mentions.

prompts.question: Does the company have a company page on CakeResume showing team size, tech stack or salary ranges?
prompts.why_it_matters: A CakeResume page confirms the company recruits technical staff locally and how it presents itself to candidates.
prompts.how_to_query: Enter the company name in CakeResume's company search and open any matching company page.
prompts.found_when: A CakeResume company page exists for the company with description, team size or open roles.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean company search on CakeResume returns no page for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search requires an account, fails to load, or the name matches several similar startups.

prompts.question: Does the company have a supplier profile in the China Economic News Service (CENS B2B) sourcing directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: A CENS supplier entry shows the company trades internationally as a Taiwanese manufacturer or exporter.

source.name: China Economic News Service (CENS B2B Sourcing)

prompts.how_to_query: Use the CENS supplier search with the company name and review any matching supplier entries.
prompts.found_when: A supplier profile in CENS lists the company with products, catalog or contact details.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean supplier search on the company name returns no CENS entry.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search results page will not load, or the name is too generic to match the right supplier.

prompts.question: Does the company hold valid product safety certifications (RPC registration or CNS Mark) in the BSMI certification lookup?
prompts.why_it_matters: A current BSMI certification shows the company may legally place its regulated products on the Taiwan market.

source.name: Bureau of Standards, Metrology and Inspection (BSMI) Certification Lookup

prompts.how_to_query: Open the BSMI certification lookup, enter the company name as applicant and review the returned certificates.
prompts.found_when: Certificates under the company name appear with a valid status and certificate number.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean lookup on the company name returns no certificates, consistent with a non-regulated product mix.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The lookup system is down, or the company name matches several applicants and certificates cannot be attributed.

prompts.question: Does the company appear in the Taiwan Intellectual Property Office (TIPO) trademark register as an applicant or owner of live trademarks?
prompts.why_it_matters: Registered trademarks prove which entity owns the brand and can reveal opposition or invalidation disputes.

source.name: Taiwan Intellectual Property Office (TIPO) Trademark Search System

prompts.how_to_query: Open the TIPO trademark search, enter the company name as applicant and review status, classes and any opposition records.
prompts.found_when: Trademark records list the company as applicant or owner with a status and Nice classes.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean applicant search on the company name returns no trademark records.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search API fails, or the applicant name matches many entities so ownership cannot be attributed.

prompts.question: Does Anue (鉅亨網) carry financial news, analyst coverage or executive interviews about the company?
prompts.why_it_matters: Financial newswire coverage shows how capital markets and analysts view the company and flags negative coverage.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Anue by the company name or stock code and read the news items and any stock profile page.
prompts.found_when: Anue publishes one or more items naming the company, its earnings or its executives.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean site search returns no Anue coverage of the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search is unavailable or the company name is a common phrase producing unrelated hits.

prompts.question: Does the company appear in the Ronnywang g0v Taiwan Company Open Data Tool with consolidated commercial registration, factory licence, tender or political-donation records?
prompts.why_it_matters: This civic aggregator cross-links official datasets, making registration gaps and conflicting records easy to spot.

source.name: Ronnywang g0v Taiwan Company Open Data Tool

prompts.how_to_query: Enter the company name or UBN in the g0v company search and open the resulting consolidated company page.
prompts.found_when: A consolidated company page appears with registration details and linked datasets for the company.
prompts.not_found_when: The search returns no company entry for the name or UBN.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The site or its API is unavailable, or the name returns many partial matches that cannot be narrowed.

prompts.question: Is the company registered with a D-U-N-S number in Dun & Bradstreet Taiwan, and do the registered name, address and parent linkage match its own claims?
prompts.why_it_matters: A D-U-N-S record confirms the entity identity and commercial credit profile used by international counterparties.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the D&B Taiwan D-U-N-S company search with the company name and open the matching company record.
prompts.found_when: A D-U-N-S record lists the company with a matching name, address or parent linkage.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean name search returns no D-U-N-S record for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The record requires a paid account, fails to load, or the name matches several registered entities.

prompts.question: Is the company listed as a member of the European Chamber of Commerce Taiwan (ECCT)?
prompts.why_it_matters: ECCT membership signals standing with European business partners and access to Taiwan policy discussions.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the ECCT membership pages and scan the member company listing for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in the ECCT member company listing.
prompts.not_found_when: No ECCT member entry exists for the company after a clean scan of the listing.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member listing is login-gated or unreadable, or the name is too common to identify the right member.

prompts.question: Does the company hold active Taiwan Food and Drug Administration (TFDA) licences as a pharmaceutical, medical device, health food or cosmetics company, and does it have any recall or border-inspection failures?
prompts.why_it_matters: TFDA licences are mandatory for regulated products, and recall or inspection failures point to quality and compliance risk.

source.name: Taiwan Food and Drug Administration (TFDA) License Lookup

prompts.how_to_query: Open the TFDA licence lookup, enter the company name as licence holder and review licences, recalls and inspection records.
prompts.found_when: Licences under the company name appear, with status, product scope and any recall or failure notices.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean lookup returns no TFDA licences, consistent with products outside TFDA scope.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The lookup service fails, or the name matches several licence holders with similar names.

prompts.question: Is the company recorded in the FINDIT Startup & Venture Database with disclosed funding rounds, investors or government subsidies?
prompts.why_it_matters: FINDIT entries corroborate funding claims and show which investors and subsidy programmes back the company.
prompts.how_to_query: Search FINDIT by the company name and open the startup profile to read funding rounds and investors.
prompts.found_when: A startup profile lists the company with funding events, investors or subsidies.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no startup profile for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The database search is unavailable, or the name matches several startups that cannot be separated.

prompts.question: Has the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) or its bureaus issued any enforcement action, sanction or penalty against the company or its management?
prompts.why_it_matters: FSC sanctions record compliance failures, accounting problems or internal-control breakdowns at regulated firms.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the FSC or Banking Bureau enforcement announcement lists and search them for the company name.
prompts.found_when: One or more FSC or bureau announcements name the company with a disposition, fine or corrective order.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search of the enforcement lists finds no announcement naming the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The announcement lists cannot be searched or are only published as unreadable PDFs.

prompts.question: Has the Fair Trade Commission (FTC) issued any sanction decision, merger approval or investigation involving the company?
prompts.why_it_matters: FTC decisions expose antitrust, cartel or deceptive-advertising findings and merger control history.

source.name: Fair Trade Commission Sanction Decisions and Public Search

prompts.how_to_query: Open the FTC decision search, enter the company name in the disposition search and review the results.
prompts.found_when: A disposition or decision letter names the company with the conduct, date and penalty.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean decision search on the company name returns no FTC decisions.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The decision search is down, or the name is too common to attribute decisions to the company.

prompts.question: Does the company have a workplace profile on GoodJob (職場透明化運動) with reported salaries, working hours or overtime data?
prompts.why_it_matters: Crowdsourced GoodJob data shows real pay and overtime practice, which can contradict employer claims.
prompts.how_to_query: Search GoodJob by the company name and open its company page to read submitted salary and working-hour entries.
prompts.found_when: A GoodJob company page exists with one or more salary, overtime or satisfaction entries.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean company search returns no GoodJob page or no submitted entries.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The site API is unavailable, or the name matches several employers with identical prefixes.

prompts.question: Is the company listed in the Chunghwa Telecom iYP Yellow Pages with a verified landline number and operating address?
prompts.why_it_matters: A verified iYP landline and address confirms the company has a real, contactable operating presence.
prompts.how_to_query: Enter the company name in the iYP search box with all cities selected and open any matching business listing.
prompts.found_when: An iYP listing shows the company with a phone number, address and business category.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean iYP search for the company name returns no business listing.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory search fails, or the name matches many unrelated local businesses.

prompts.question: Does the company, its legal representatives or subsidiaries appear in the Judicial Yuan Law and Judgment Search System as a party to civil, criminal or enforcement proceedings?
prompts.why_it_matters: Court records reveal debt defaults, contract disputes, criminal charges and bankruptcy that filings do not show.

source.name: Judicial Yuan Law and Judgment Search System

prompts.how_to_query: Open the judgment search, enter the company name as a party in the full-text or party field and review the result list.
prompts.found_when: Judgments or rulings list the company, its representatives or subsidiaries as a party.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean party search on the company name returns no judgments.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search requires a captcha that cannot be solved, or the name is too common to attribute cases.

prompts.question: Does the company sell on the momo Shopping Network as a listed seller or as the brand behind products on the platform?
prompts.why_it_matters: Presence on momo confirms an active retail channel and can test claims of authorised distribution.
prompts.how_to_query: Enter the company or brand name in the momo search bar and check both seller results and product listings.
prompts.found_when: A seller page or product listings on momo are attributed to the company or its brand.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no seller and no product listings tied to the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The platform blocks scraping, or the name is generic and results cannot be tied to the company.

prompts.question: Does the company appear in MoneyDJ's Industry Value Chain Platform or stock pages as a listed manufacturer with named customers or suppliers?
prompts.why_it_matters: Value-chain mapping shows who the company really supplies and buys from, testing supply-chain and partnership claims.

source.name: MoneyDJ (理財網 & 產業價值鏈資訊平台)

prompts.how_to_query: Search MoneyDJ by the company name or stock code, then open its stock page and value-chain entry.
prompts.found_when: A MoneyDJ page lists the company with industry position, upstream/downstream links or counterparties.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no company page or value-chain entry for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The site blocks requests, or the company is unlisted and only loosely named on the platform.

prompts.question: Does the company's facility appear in the Ministry of Environment PRTR and Pollution Tracking Database with emission records or environmental sanctions?
prompts.why_it_matters: PRTR records show pollution releases and environmental fines that signal operational and regulatory risk.

source.name: Ministry of Environment PRTR and Pollution Tracking Database

prompts.how_to_query: Open the PRTR facility search, enter the company name as facility name and review permits, releases and penalties.
prompts.found_when: Facility records under the company name show permits, chemical releases or environmental penalties.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean facility search returns no records, consistent with no tracked industrial facility.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The PRTR search API fails, or the company operates through a factory name that cannot be matched.

prompts.question: Does the company have an employer review page on Qollie (求職天眼通) with ratings or complaints from employees?
prompts.why_it_matters: Anonymous Qollie reviews surface management, overtime and turnover problems reported by former staff.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Qollie by the company name and open its company page to read the submitted reviews and ratings.
prompts.found_when: A Qollie company page exists with one or more employee reviews or ratings.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean company search returns no Qollie page for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The site is offline or the API returns nothing readable, or the name matches several employers.

prompts.question: Is the company listed in the member directory of the General Chamber of Commerce of the Republic of China (ROCCOC), or named among its business award winners?
prompts.why_it_matters: ROCCOC membership or awards show recognition by Taiwan's peak domestic commercial body.

source.name: General Chamber of Commerce of the Republic of China (ROCCOC)

prompts.how_to_query: Open the ROCCOC member and award listing pages and scan them for the company name.
prompts.found_when: The company appears in a ROCCOC member, federation or award-winner listing.
prompts.not_found_when: No ROCCOC listing mentions the company after a clean scan of the member and award pages.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The listing pages are unreadable, paginated too deeply, or the name is too common to match.

prompts.question: Does StatementDog (財報狗) carry a company page for the company, and do the financial metrics shown agree with its reported figures?
prompts.why_it_matters: Independent fundamental analysis flags margin erosion, inventory risk and cash-cycle problems that contradict upbeat claims.
prompts.how_to_query: Search StatementDog by company name or stock code and open its company page to compare the computed metrics.
prompts.found_when: A StatementDog company page exists with financial metrics or community commentary on the company.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean search returns no StatementDog page, typical for unlisted companies.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The site requires login, blocks the request, or the company is unlisted with no comparable data.

prompts.question: Is the company's laboratory, calibration facility or inspection body accredited by the Taiwan Accreditation Foundation (TAF) to ISO/IEC 17025, ISO 15189 or ISO/IEC 17021?
prompts.why_it_matters: Valid TAF accreditation is the proof that test reports and certificates issued by the company are internationally recognised.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the TAF accreditation listing, enter the company or laboratory name and review the returned accreditation items.
prompts.found_when: The TAF listing shows the company or its laboratory with a valid accreditation and standard.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean listing search returns no accredited laboratory under the company name, consistent with no accreditation claim.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The listing endpoint fails, or the laboratory name differs from the company name and cannot be linked.

prompts.question: Does the company have a verified supplier profile on Taiwantrade with its factory certifications and export product catalogues?
prompts.why_it_matters: A Taiwantrade supplier profile shows verified export capability and which certifications the company actually holds.
prompts.how_to_query: Enter the company name in Taiwantrade's supplier search and open the matching supplier detail page.
prompts.found_when: A Taiwantrade supplier detail page lists the company with products, certifications or verification badges.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean supplier search returns no Taiwantrade profile for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search fails or the name is too generic to identify the right supplier among many.

prompts.question: Is the company a member of the Taiwan Association of Machinery Industry (TAMI) with a member factory listing?
prompts.why_it_matters: TAMI membership confirms the company is a recognised Taiwanese machinery builder rather than a trading intermediary.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the TAMI member directory search, enter the company name and open any matching member detail page.
prompts.found_when: A TAMI member detail page lists the company with products or factory information.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean member search returns no TAMI listing for the company, consistent with a non-machinery business.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The member directory search is unavailable, or the name matches several members with similar prefixes.

prompts.question: Does the Taiwan Depository & Clearing Corporation (TDCC) equity dispersion table show the company's shareholding structure by bracket, and has the large-holder distribution shifted recently?
prompts.why_it_matters: TDCC dispersion data shows whether control is concentrated or retail-held and flags major shareholder accumulation or dumping.

source.name: Taiwan Depository & Clearing Corporation (TDCC Equity Dispersion Database)

prompts.how_to_query: Open the TDCC equity dispersion query page, enter the company's stock code and read the bracket table for recent weeks.
prompts.found_when: Dispersion tables exist for the company's stock code with bracket percentages across weeks.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean query returns no dispersion table, typical for a non-listed company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The query form fails or the company is unlisted and has no stock code to query.

prompts.question: Is the company listed in the Taiwan Electrical and Electronic Manufacturers' Association (TEEMA) member or B2B company directory?
prompts.why_it_matters: TEEMA membership corroborates claims of being an electronics or ICT hardware manufacturer in Taiwan.

source.name: Taiwan Electrical and Electronic Manufacturers' Association (TEEMA)

prompts.how_to_query: Use the TEEMA B2B company search with the company name and open any matching member company page.
prompts.found_when: A TEEMA company listing shows the company with products or member details.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean company search returns no TEEMA listing, consistent with a non-electronics business.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The directory search fails, or the name is too generic to identify the right member.

prompts.question: Does the company have a company profile on Wenbi All-Products Taiwan (ttnet.net) showing factory location, equipment or trade capacity?
prompts.why_it_matters: A ttnet profile shows whether the company is a real OEM/ODM factory with production capacity, not only a trader.
prompts.how_to_query: Enter the manufacturer name in the ttnet company search and open the matching company profile.
prompts.found_when: A ttnet company profile lists the company with factory information, equipment or products.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean company search returns no ttnet profile for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The search page fails to load, or the name matches many similarly named factories.

prompts.question: Does the Twincn company information directory show a registry entry for the company with consistent capital history, directors and affiliated companies?
prompts.why_it_matters: Twincn aggregates commercial registry data, so director and capital history can be cross-checked for inconsistencies.
prompts.how_to_query: Open the Twincn search with the company name or UBN and open the matching company record.
prompts.found_when: A registry record lists the company with capital, directors, supervisors and related companies.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean name or UBN search returns no registry record for the company.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The site blocks the request, or the name matches many companies and the UBN is unknown.

prompts.question: Does the TWSE WebPro system host investor conference (法人說明會) videos or press announcements presented by the company's management?
prompts.why_it_matters: Recorded investor briefings let a researcher compare management's own statements with the company's filings and claims.
prompts.how_to_query: Use the WebPro investor search with the company name or stock code and open any matching briefing videos.
prompts.found_when: WebPro lists one or more investor conference videos or announcements for the company.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean keyword search returns no WebPro recordings, typical for unlisted companies.
prompts.couldnt_check_when: The video archive search fails, or the company is unlisted and has no briefings indexed.

prompts.question: Does the company appear as a hiring employer on yes123 Job Bank with contact details and wage ranges for its vacancies?
prompts.why_it_matters: A yes123 employer listing confirms active SME hiring and shows the pay levels the company publicly advertises.
prompts.how_to_query: Enter the company name in yes123's job keyword search and open any matching company or vacancy pages.
prompts.found_when: yes123 shows a company page or vacancies under the company name with contact or wage details.
prompts.not_found_when: A clean name search returns no company page or vacancies for the company.
